Commentary.Commentary: Not that Cremer didn't bowl well but he got a 4-fer as the Lankans threw it away in quest of scoring quick runs. The hosts now have a huge task ahead of them and will have to bat out of their skins just like they did in the first Test. One would feel, they won't go for the chase but the question is, with a session and half remaining today and 3 full sessions tomorrow, result is a sureity. Will Zimbabwe put up a fight? Or will Herath and co. wrap it up quickly and win the series 2-0? Join us in a bit for the run chase.

And there comes the call from the Sri Lankan dressing room, Rangana Herath has had enough and has set a target of 491 runs in front of the hosts. As expected, Sri Lanka after lunch came out all guns blazing but only thing that didn't work was a deserving ton for Dimuth Karunaratne who was shown the way to pavilion on 88. Kusal Perera then took over the reins and just crashed-banged-walloped to take the lead to as much as possible.

OUT! CREMER GETS A KUSAL BREAKTHROUGH! Obviously not in terms of the game, but it's still an important one. Kusal Perera comes down the track and takes it on the full. He looks to clear the long on fence but instead finds the man there. Sean Williams is positioned there and he does well to settle himself under the ball and take a good reverse cup. And with that, SRI LANKA HAVE DECLARED ON 258/9!
SIX! THAT'S A BIG ONE! Full toss outside off, Kusal Perera skips down the track and murders it over the wide long on boundary for a maximum.
FOUR! That's smashed! Full on the stumps, Perera makes room and hammers it straight down the ground to send it all the way.
Nice from Cremer. Seeing Perera dancing down the wicket he drags the length back on this one. The southpaw is cramped for room and the ball goes off the pads.
The batsman was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.
FOUR! Angling in on middle and leg, Lakmal just works it ever so well through the square leg region to pick up a boundary.
Length ball from Mumba, Lakmal gets an inside edge onto his pads as he tries to play at it.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
High full toss around off, it's whacked towards the cover fielder for nothing.
Angled across the southpaw, looks to work it fine but misses.
Second new ball is due now...
Loopy ball around middle and off, Lakmal chips it back to the bowler and is lucky as the ball falls just short of Cremer who tries to take it by diving forward in his followthrough.
Tossed up ball on middle, Kusal comes down the track and knocks it down to long on for a single.

Leading edge but safe... Floats it up around middle, Lakmal looks to flick it across the line but closes the face of the bat early as the ball goes off the leading edge towards covers. The fielder there could do nothing about it was the ball was very far from his reach. A single taken.
Outside leg, Lakmal goes for the pull but fails to go on with the shot.
Looped up on off, it's defended solidly off the front foot.
3rd Test fifty for Kusal Perera!
Loopy ball around middle and off, milked down the ground towards long on for a single. Fine knock from the Lankan keeper!
FOUR! Back of a length ball on middle, rises at a nice height too. Lakmal latches onto it as he swivels and pulls it firmly in front of square for a gorgeous boundary.
Short and down the leg side, Lakmal looks to pull it down the leg side but fails to do so.
Touch short and outside off, punched through covers for a couple.
Good length delivery on off, Suranga defends it down into the ground.
Fuller in length and outside off, Lakmal looks to drive this one but misses it completely.
Length ball served wide outside off, Kusal cuts it through point for a single. Moves onto 49!
Carl Mumba is back on to bowl.
Around middle and leg, worked towards mid-wicket.

In the air... safe! Loopy ball around off, Kusal comes down the track to hit it down the ground but miscues it towards long off. The fielder comes running in to take it but the ball falls well short of him. One run taken.
The batsman has swept that one through the leg side.
Loopy ball around off, Perera looks to swipe it across the line but gets an inside edge on the pads as the ball lobs back to the right of the bowler.
Short and turning in, Perera rocks back and punches it through covers for a couple.

NOT OUT! The decision stays as it is! Tosses it up outside off, turning in sharply after pitching. Perera gets down to play the reverse sweep but misses and is hit on the pads. An appeal is made but the umpire says not out. Cremer takes the review and replays show it was pitched outside off and was going on to clip the leg stump. Hence the umpire's call stays.
An LBW appeal against Perera is taken upstairs!
Fuller on the stumps, Lakmal bunts it past the bowler's right.
FOUR! And more! Runs coming thick and fast at the moment! Fuller in length and sparyed on the pads, Suranga just tickles it down to fine leg for back-to-back boundaries.
FOUR! Top edge! Short of a length ball on middle and off, Lakmal looks to go for the pull but gets a thick top edge that flies over the keeper and to the third man fence for a boundary.
Back of a length ball on middle, pulled in front of square for a single.
Swing and miss! On a good length and outside off, Lakmal comes down the track and gives it a full swing of the bat but fails to get bat on it.
Slower full ball on middle, knocked down the ground towards long on for a single.

FOUR! Swept away this time! Loopy ball around middle and off, Perera gets down on one knee and sweeps it off the inner part of the bat through square leg for another boundary. Boundaries are raining here for SL.
FOUR! Loopy ball around middle and off, Perera gets into the position early and plays the reverse sweep to perfection through point for a boundary.
Flatter ball around middle, it's the wrong 'un. Lakmal flicks it somehow through square leg for a single.
Suranga Lakmal is the next man in to bat.

OUT! Cremer has another! This was a yorker from the Zimbabwe skipper that has done his opposite number in. Full and around off, Herath looks to sweep it across the line but is beaten and the off pole is out of the ground. What a ball and Sri Lanka lose another and lead by 443!
Tossed up ball around off, Perera flat bats it down to long on for a single.
FOUR! Boom! Cremer bowls a loopy ball outside off, Perera stays put and goes bang over extra cover for a boundary. Lovely shot, this is declaration batting.
Another bouncer. It's ducked and evaded as well.
Christopher bangs it in short on middle, Rangi ducks and evades it.
Tight line, not giving Herath much room, it's kept out off the back foot.
FOUR! Edged and away! Fuller ball outside off, Herath throws his bat at this. The ball takes a thick edge and flies down towards third man for a boundary.
Another one which is pitched right up there, around off, Kusal Perera drives it to mid off and scurries to the other end to complete the single.
Spears a full ball way outside off, it's left alone for the keeper to collect.
Rangana Herath is the new man in!

OUT! Another wicket down for Sri Lanka! Cremer bowls it slower through the air and tosses it up outside leg, it's turning as Dilruwan Perera kneels down to sweep it away. He's a bit early into the shot as the ball goes off his glove and into Masakadza's hands at first slip.
Drags the length back on this, it's turning to off from outside leg, Dilruwan Perera looks to pull it away but is hit high on the thigh pad.
Overpitched outside off, it's eased down to long off for one easy run.
Full ball once more, swept to short fine leg.
Looped up around off, Kusal looks to sweep it away but misses and is hit on the pads.
From around the wicket, it's loopy and on a fullish length, looking for the rough, it's worked comfortably on the leg side for a run.

Well fielded. Back of a length delivery around off, Kusal Perera rocks back in a jiffy and pulls it hard. Unfortunately for him, it's straight to the fielder at mid-wicket who's standing right at the edge of the circle.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Run out chance goes begging. Back of a length delivery outside off, Dilruwan stays back and hits it towards cover-point. Sets off for the single and there's a big confusion as both batsmen are stranded in the middle. But much to their delight, the fielder misfields it and that allows the batsmen to take a single.
Dilruwan Perera walks in next!

OUT! DIMUTH IS DISMISSED! How unfortunate for the left-hander, he's missed out on what would have been a well-deserved ton. Mpofu comes running in and pitches it just back of a length on middle and leg, Karunaratne looks to keep it out off the back foot but the ball keeps just a little low. He's rapped on the pads and there are loud appeals for a leg before. The umpire raises his finger but Dimuth wants to take the review, despite it looking plumb, and you can't even blame him really. Replays confirm he's gone. He now has to make the long walk back.
Karunaratne is adjudged LBW but he wants to take the review. Looks plumb to the naked eye.
Length ball on off stump, kept out from within the crease.
Pitched marginally ahead of a length, around the off stump, defended off the front foot.
Kusal Perera reverse sweeps this fuller ball away. Didn't exactly middle it but it's enough to get him two runs as the ball rolls away down to third man.
Bowls it quicker through the air and pitches it outside off, kept out solidly.

Heavy turn for Graeme Cremer as he pitches it on a length, comes in sharply and takes the inside edge off Perera's bat as he backs away to punch it to the off side. Two runs are taken as the ball rolls away on the on side.

Play and a miss! Cremer gives this a lot of air and floats it up outside off, it's coming very slow through the air as Perera is quite early into his sweep shot. Misses and it's collected by the keeper.
Turning in from outside off, on a full length, it's tapped in front of point for another quick run.

Extremely full delivery on middle and off, Kusal Perera manages to squeeze it out in front of covers. The fielder there charges to the ball and fires a wayward throw as the batsmen complete a quick single.
Short one banged in on middle and off, angling in, it's pulled away through square leg for a single. End of the over.
Comes from around the wicket and takes the pace off as well, Perera is too early in the shot as he looks to go big down the ground. He's in attack mode here now.
FOUR! FETCH THAT! Fullish outside off, room to free his arms again, Kusal Perera smacks it through the cover region to send it all the way. Hit that hard, didn't he?
Some swerve on that, slightly slower in pace as well, 106 kph, it's defended back in the direction of the bowler with a straight blade.
Fuller length ball on off stump, Kusal Perera is rock solid in his defense as he stands his ground to keep it out.

FOUR! CRACKING SHOT! Lovely loosener after lunch. Length ball outside off, a lot of room on offer and Perera latches onto this in a flash. Crashes it through the gap in the covers off the back foot and picks up a boundary early in the session.
Christopher Mpofu will bowl from the other end.
Floated around off, pushed in front of covers off the front foot. Dot ball to end the over.
A lot of flight given to this, it's turning in from outside off, Dimuth is hit on the body as he misses his attempted sweep shot.
Loopy and fullish in length around off, Perera closes the face and works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Turning in from a length, worked to the leg side off the back foot.
FOUR! Turn and bounce for Cremer but it's still put away. Outside off, it's reverse swept across the third man fence for a boundary. Nicely played.
Starts off with a tossed up leg-spinner outside off, Karunaratne gets to the pitch of the delivery and drives it down to long on for a single.
We are back for the post-Lunch session. It will be Dimuth Karunaratne and Kusal Perera to continue. Graeme Cremer will take the ball first up.
... DAY 4, SESSION 2 ...

The hosts did bowl well as Mpofu and Mumba controlled the scoring rate at the start and then Cremer brought himself into the attack and asked several questions to the batsmen by pitching it near the rough patch. The question is, with a massive lead or one can say a match-winning lead already in the kitty, how much more will Sri Lanka want before they declare? One would feel Zimbabwe will bat anytime soon in the next session. Join us back shortly.

That's another fine session for Sri Lanka! They have swelled the lead to 400 now and have completely taken the game away from Zimbabwe. Dimuth Karunaratne and Asela Gunaratne started really slow as they were happy to take time to settle but once they got their eyes in, runs started to flow. The latter was rapped on the pads by Tiripano but the former is still out there and looks set for a ton here. He has Kusal Perera who has just walked in for company.
Back of a length delivery on off, Perera punches it back to the bowler. THAT'S LUNCH ON DAY 4!
Fullish length delivery outside off, Perera leaves it alone.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Dimuth Karunaratne backs away and cuts it to deep point for a single.
Pitched right up there outside off, DK plants his front foot forward and drives it to the cover region.
Pitched just ahead of a length outside off, Dimuth looks to hit it through the covers but ends up skewing it off the inner half towards mid off.
Full delivery fired outside off, it's driven to wide mid off.
Gets to the pitch of the ball and works it through mid-wicket for a run to end the over.
Loopy and pitched on a length outside off, DK backs away and steers it to short third man.
Bowls it slower through the air, outside off, Perera chops it to point for one.
Quicker one of off, blocked.
Full and loopy on the stumps, Dimuth skips down the track and drives it to long on for a single.

Starts off with a shorter and flat delivery outside off, Karunaratne waits for it and plays it very late. Guides it down towards third man where Hamilton Masakadza puts in a solid dive to keep the ball from the ropes. Great effort as the big man keeps the batsmen down to two runs.
Sean Williams comes on to bowl.
Length delivery on the fifth stump line, it's punched in front of covers off the back foot. That's a maiden over for Masakadza.
On the fuller side once more, Kusal Perera shoulders his arms to this one.
Full and aiming the base of off stump, KP pushes it past the cover fielder but doesn't get any run for it.
Tight line from Hamilton Masakadza, it's on a length this time just around off, Kusal Perera opens the face and taps it in front of covers.
Fuller in length and pitched outside off, left alone once more.
Masakadza starts off with a slower one, bowls a full toss outside off, Perera leaves it alone.
Hamilton Masakadza is brought into the bowling attack.
The batsman has driven it through mid off. One run added to the total.
Turning in from around off, swept through the leg side for one run.
Full and looped up on the stumps, driven to mid on.
DK once again sweeps this one away but this time it's straight to the fielder.
Graeme tosses it well outside off, Dimuth drags the sweep through backward square leg. A misfield from the fielder out in the deep allows the batsmen to come back for the second.
Perera makes good use of his feet and works it through mid-wicket to pick up a single.
Donald once again pitches it up there, it's kept out off the front foot.
Full on off, driven back down the ground for no run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Length ball angling in from outside off, Dimuth gets an edge which flies towards third man. Two runs are taken.
Dimuth Karunaratne has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
From around the wicket, Tiripano bowls a fuller ball outside off, Dimuth looks to drives it but plays it off the inner half back to the bowler.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full on the stumps, driven to mid on for a single.

Cremer tosses this one up outside off, Perera goes for the reverse sweep but ends up dragging it off the bottom edge past the keeper. It seems to be running away to the fence but the fielder out in the deep stops it with his foot. Three runs are taken.
Another fullish delivery but attacking the stumps this time, it's pushed back down the ground.
Full and floated around off, defended.
High full toss around off, Karunaratne walks down the track and hits it to long on for one.
The batsman has punched that ball through the off side.
Fuller in length as Donald pitches it up there, it's kept out off the front foot. Bunted back in the direction of the bowler.
Tiripano brings out the short one and bangs it in hard, Kusal Perera ducks under it nicely and evades.
Another full ball on middle and off, it's driven to mid on.
Slightly fullish in length and aimed on off stump, it's played off the front foot back down the track.
Length delivery outside off, it's played to point for a single.
The batsman has attempted to put bat on ball but fails.
Leg-spinner outside off, Kusal Perera gets an edge as he steps out to play that one. It lobs towards short third man and falls safely.
Another sweep attempt missed. Graeme drags the length back on this one as Perera looks to sweep. Is hit on the body and that's a dot ball.
Full on the stumps, KP looks to sweep but ends up hitting it into the track and then it goes on to hit his boot.

FOUR! Cremer finds the outside edge but it hasn't carried. How unfortunate. No reward for a good delivery. It's nicely looped up outside off, it's turning in as Perera looks to defend it into the track. Gets an edge which falls just short of the man at first slip. And to add insult to injury, it goes past him and away to the fence behind.
Graeme Cremer continues from around the wicket and tosses up a leg breaker outside off, Dimuth kneels down and sweeps it down towards fine leg for a single.
Oooohhh... That almost sneaked through. Length delivery on off stump, it keeps quite low as well. Perera does well to bring his bat down in time and just about keep it out.
Kusal Perera is the new man in!

OUT! ASELA IS GONE! Finally, after a relatively long struggle it's Donald Tiripano who has got the breakthrough. He comes running in and angles in a fuller length ball on middle and off, Gunaratne leans across in an attempt to flick it away but misses and is rapped right in front of the stumps. No trouble for the umpire to raise his finger as that's dead plumb. The 69-run stand has been broken and it's just what Zimbabwe needed.
Just around the off stump, it's kept out by getting right behind the line.
The batsman drives the ball straight down the ground.
Shortish delivery outside off, it's punched to point for no run.
Sprays this on the pads, no trouble for the southpaw to glance this down to fine leg for one run.

That was a nasty one! Ripper from Graeme Cremer. Bowls it outside leg, extracts a lot of bounce off the deck and there's a lot of turn as well. Catch Gunaratne on the arm as he caught in no man's land when playing that. Maybe it went off the glove. Had there been a silly point in place, things could have gotten really interesting. Great delivery to end the over.
Similar delivery, once again it's padded away.
Comes from around the wicket now, flights it well around leg, it's turning towards off as Asela pads it away.

FOUR! That's a beautiful shot. The timing on that was absolutely superb. Tossed up on off stump, Gunaratne clears his front leg a bit, waits for the ball to bounce and drives it ever so well past the mid off fielder to send it all the way.
Full and loopy outside off, eased to the cover region. Won't get any run for it, though.
Cremer tosses it up and bowls it slower through the air, on middle and off, it's driven to mid on.
Fuller in length on the stumps, Dimuth gets an inside edge onto his pads as he closes the face to work it to mid-wicket.

Shouts for an lbw which are turned down. Rightly so, the ball pitched outside the line of leg stump. It came in sharply and beat Karunaratne as he tried to flick it across the line, rapping him on the pads but to no avail.
Fuller in the corridor outside off, drawing the batsman forward to drive, he obliges and pushes it off the toe end towards short extra cover.
A little wider outside off, on a length once more, Karunaratne dabs it towards gully with an open face but is unable to beat the diving fielder there.
Tight line once more from Tiripano, it's kept out from within the crease by the southpaw.
Length delivery just outside off, Dimuth gets a bottom edge towards cover-point as he attempts to cut it away.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Looped up once more, some decent flight provided by the Zimbabwean skipper, it's defended off the front foot.
Graeme floats this one up on middle and off, gets a bit of turn as well, AG gets behind the line of the delivery and keeps it out.
FOUR! Brilliantly played. Short and wide outside off, on a flatter trajectory as well, Asela Gunaratne backs away a bit and cuts it late to send it across the third man boundary.
Once again Dimuth Karunaratne dances down the track and eases it down to long on for a single.
Attacking the stumps here, Dimuth steps out of the crease and plays it back to the bowler.
Fuller length ball aimed at off stump, it's pushed back down to mid on to end the over.
FOUR! Lovely placement. Length delivery outside off, Asela waits for it, opens the face of the blade and runs it down to third man to pick up a boundary.
Another one which keeps a little low, it's crunched through the point region for a run.
This one keeps a bit low as Donald Tiripano angles across a length delivery, Dimuth Karunaratne hangs back and manages to punch it to point.
On a good length outside off, Asela Gunaratne gets back and punches it through cover-point to pick up an easy single.
Starts off with a fullish length delivery in the channel outside off, Gunaratne strides forward and raises his bat skyward to let it go past him.
Donald Tiripano is brought into the attack for the first time today.
Bowls it slower through the air and pitches it outside off, it's run down to third man for a single to end the over.
Gunaratne has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Slightly shorter in length this time, around the off stump, Gunaratne stays back and keeps it out easily.
Cremer tosses it up on off stump, Asela presses forward and keeps it out with a solid straight blade.
Short and flat on middle, turning in to the left-hander, it's worked through square leg off the back foot for an easy single.
Drinks time at Harare!
Fuller and hurled on the pads, flicked through square leg for a single.
Length ball in the corridor outside off, Karunaratne lifts his bat and lets it go.
Very wide outside off, Dimuth will never go after it.
50-run stand is up between Karunaratne and Gunaratne!
FOUR! Too easy for Dimuth! Mpofu drifts it on the pads, Karunaratne just helps it on its way down to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Fuller in length and outside off, solidly defended by DK.
Fuller in length and outside off, driven towards the man at extra cover.
Loopy ball around off, Asela defends it watchfully.
Opens the face of the bat and pushes it towards point.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Loopy leg spinner around middle and off, buried into the ground.
Gets forward and blocks it out well.
What a ball! Floated ball around middle, turns away sharply with some bounce on it. Gunaratne looks to defend but is completely beaten.
Graeme Cremer into the attack now!
Fuller in length on off, defended down gently.
Fuller in length and outside off, DK drives it towards mid off and Asela wanted a single. Karunaratne shouts NO and sends him back. There is a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
FOUR! Mpofu's maiden over run is over! Short and outside off, Karunarante looks to cut but gets it off the bottom part of the bat past a diving first slip for a boundary.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Good length delivery on off, Karunaratne defends it gently.
Good length delivery on off, DK stands tall and defends it down into the ground.
On a good length on off, pushed towards point.
On a good length outside off, Gunaratne looks to cut but the ball doesn't rise and he gets beaten.
Fullish on the pads, Asela gets across and defends it towards the leg side.
Angles in a length ball on middle, Gunaratne looks to defend but gets an inside edge through the legs towards the leg side.
In the channel outside off, AG shoulders his arms to that one.
FOUR! Creamed! Fuller in length and outside off, Gunaratne leans into it and drives it nicely through mid off for a boundary along the ground.
Shortish outside off, DK cuts it towards backward point where the fielder puts in a dive to his right to stop a boundary. That's the 6th Maiden in a row for Mpofu!
Back of a length ball on off, punched towards the man at extra cover.
Fuller in length and outside off, defended towards the off side.
Punched off the backfoot by the batsman.
Christopher brings out the slower one and pitches it just ahead of a length, Karunaratne, who had stepped out to drive this one, had to adjust and ended up playing it towards point.
Length delivery just outside the off stump, Dimuth stays within his crease and keeps it out solidly.
Outside off, played to point for no run.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Carl fires this one right in the blockhole, on off stump, Asela just about manages to bring his bat down in time and squeeze it out in front of gully.
Fuller in length this time and outside off, it's driven to mid off for nothing.

FOUR! Poor delivery from Carl and he pays the price for it. Straying on the hips, Gunaratne whips it hard through backward square leg and beats the diving fielder out in the deep to get a boundary to his name.
Back of a length delivery from Carl Mumba, it's defended off the back foot.
DK prods forward and pushes it towards covers. He looks for a single but won't get it.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and defends it into the ground.
Slightly fuller on off, Dimuth drives it but finds the man at covers.
Good length delivery outside off, defended off the back foot.
On middle and leg, pushed towards mid on this time.
Fuller in length and outside off, driven straight to extra cover.

In the air... dropped! Waller is the culprit! Fuller and angling in on middle, Gunaratne gets across and tries to flick it on the leg side. He does so but fails to keep it down as Waller at square leg tries to pouch a reverse cup catch over his head but the ball bursts off his fingers and goes through. They take two runs.
FOUR! Pulled away nicely! Touch short and comes at a nice height too. Asela swivels and pulls it through square leg for a boundary. Beautifully done!
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Uppish but safe... Fuller in length and outside off, Karunaratne leans into it and drives it uppishly towards covers for a single. It was in the air for a while but no harm done.
Angles in a length ball on middle, clipped towards short mid-wicket.
Comes from around the wicket and bowls it very full on off. It's squeezed out towards covers.
Touch full and served on off, defended towards the off side.
Fuller in length and outside off, Gunaratne drives it towards covers for nothing.
Stays behind the line and defends it down gently.
Sprayed down the leg side, Gunaratne looks to flick but misses.
Back of a length ball on off, with some width too. Asela gets back and looks to crunch it through the off side but finds point.
Fuller in length on off, pushed back to Mpofu.
Fuller in length on off, driven nicely but finds the man at mid off.
Angles away a length ball outside off, DK looks to cut but is beaten all ends up.

FOUR! Superb shot! A low full toss on off, Karunaratne leans into it and bunts it down the ground past the non-striker. The mid off fielder dives to his left but can't stop it from racing away to the fence.
Very full and sprayed on the pads, worked behind square on the leg side for a single.
Fuller and tailing back in sharply as Gunaratne misses his flick and is hit on the pads.
On a good length and around off, defended from within the crease.
Good length ball on middle and leg, tucked towards mid-wicket for nothing.
On a good length and outside off, Dimuth opens the face of the blade and glides it towards gully where the fielder puts in a dive to his right to stop a certain boundary.
Fuller and angling in, Dimuth gets back and wrists this towards the fielder at mid on.
Very full on off, just a gentle push towards covers.
Fuller in length on off, defended solidly from the crease.
Fuller in length on off, the batsman comes forward and pushes it back to Mpofu.
Served too wide outside off to make Asela play at it.
Fullish in length on off, defended towards covers.

FOUR! Edged and that's first runs on the board for the day! Fuller in length and around off, Gunaratne gets squared up a bit and that does him in. Gets a thick outside edge which flies past a diving first slip fielder for a boundary towards third man.
Back of a length ball on off, rises off the deck as well. AG shoulders his arms to that one.
Fuller and angling in, defended nicely by covering the line.
Back of a length ball on off, Asela gets back and fends it on the off side.
Stays in the crease and keeps it out gently. Another maiden.
Fuller on middle and off, Dimuth gets forward and drives it back to the bowler who fails to collect and the ball goes towards mid on.
Fuller in length and outside off, Dimuth prods forward and blocks it solidly.
Fuller on the pads, bunted towards the man at mid on.
Beaten! Good length ball on off, Karunaratne looks to cut it through the off side but the ball doesn't rise at all and he gets beaten due to the lack of bounce.
Fuller on the stumps, driven back to the bowler.
Angles in a full length delivery, the batsman gets across a bit and flicks it towards the leg side. So, back-to-back maidens to start the day with.
On a good length and around off, Gunaratne opens the face of the bat and defends it towards gully.
Gets behind the line and defends it with a straight bat back to the bowler.
Fuller in length and in the channel outside off, AG makes an easy leave to Moor.
Back of a length ball outside off, Gunaratne gets back and taps it on the off side.
On a good length and outside off, Asela lifts his bat and allows it to go through to the keeper.
Carl Mumba will bowl from the other end!
Length ball outside off, Karunaratne cuts it towards the man at gully.
Length ball, curling in as well, Dimuth gets behind the line and defends it down the track.
In the corrirdor on off, DK has got nothing to do with that one.
Good length on off, it's punched off the back foot towards short cover.
On a good length and just outside off, Dimuth shoulders his arms to that one.
Starts with a fuller length delivery, wide outside off, Karunaratne makes an easy leave to the keeper.

It's time to get underway. The umpires and players have made their way out to the middle. It will be Dimuth Karunaratne and Asela Gunaratne to continue for the Lankans. Zimbabwe start with Christopher Mpofu. Let's play...

Hello and a warm welcome for day 4 of this final Test between Zimbabwe and Sri Lanka. The visitors have swelled the lead to 334 now in spite of losing 4 wickets yesterday. Dimuth Karunaratne kept hold at one end and has already crossed the 50-run mark. He has Asela Gunaratne for company and the duo would look to bat the hosts out once the play resumes. Zimbabwe would look to take quick wickets and not allow the Lankans to score freely. The Test is firmly in the grip of the Lankans as of now and it would be interesting to see when will SL declare. Stay tuned as the action is about to start...
... DAY 4, SESSION 1...

The pitch will only start to crumble and batting on this deck will be all the more difficult from tomorrow. So, how much will Herath and co. feel is enough to bowl out the hosts again? Will the Rhodesians put up a fight? Let's see how the penultimate day pans out. Join us back tomorrow at 1330 IST for all the action. Goodnight and take care! Cheers!

Zimbabwe after having failed with the bat, came out hard with the ball and it was Carl Mumba who did all the damage. He got a 3-fer and looks hungry for more. Skipper Cremer struck in his very first over but some resistance from Dimuth Karunaratne with a fine fifty saw Sri Lanka still having an upper hand as far as the context of the game is concerned. His side lead by a massive 334 runs and have half a dozen wickets remaining.

That brings us to the end of another fascinating day of Test cricket. Late on day 2, it seemed like Zimbabwe will put up a fight but that didn't happen as the Lankans were right on the money today and bowled out the hosts for 272, gaining a lead of 232 with the same. Once again Herath led from the front and became only the 3rd bowler to register a 5-fer against all the 9 Test playing nations. He didn't enforce the follow-on and it didn't exactly work in his team's favour as they are reduced to 102/4.
Length ball angling down leg, Dimuth Karunaratne swivels across and pulls it down to fine leg for a single. THAT WILL BE STUMPS ON DAY 3!
Full outside off, eased away to short cover.
Around the wicket now to the left-hander, Chari angles it in as Dimuth blocks.
Coming in on middle and leg, it's pitched on a fuller length, Asela easily works it through the mid-wicket region and picks up a single.
Length ball outside off, Gunaratne with an angled bat plays it straight to backward point.
Fuller length ball on the pads, it's clipped down to fine leg for a comfortable run.
Brian Chari comes on to bowl the final over of the day. Can he produce some late drama?
Too straight from Sean, it's worked towards mid-wicket to end the over.
Williams gives this a decent amount of flight and tosses it up around off, Asela leans ahead and defends with a solid bat.
Floated on the stumps, it's kept out off the front foot.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Flatter delivery around off, it's punched back to Williams.
Short and wide outside off, Dimuth cuts it to sweeper cover for one run.
FOUR BYES! Cremer brings out the googly and nobody picks it up. Not the batsman, not even the keeper. It goes down the leg side, beats everybody and rolls away to the fence.
Asela Gunaratne has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Another flatter delivery on the stumps, some nice drift on that occasion from Graeme Cremer, Gunaratne stays back and keeps it out.
Flatter and shorter outside off, it's punched away to the off side for a run.
Makes good use of his feet and drives it to mid on.
Turning in on middle and leg, it's turned on the on side for nothing.
Cremer is back on.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
On a length and outside off, punched away for no run.
Gunaratne has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
From around the wicket, floats it up outside off, arms are shouldered to this one.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
10th Test fifty for Dimuth Karunaratne!
Steps out to this floated ball and flicks it to deep mid-wicket. Brings up his fifty with that. He's kept on scoring the runs here. Brilliant knock so far.
That one had a lot of movement in it. Pitched outside off and it's shaping in heavily, Gunaratne makes a good leave.
FOUR! Overpitched on middle and leg, it's flicked through the square leg region nicely. Nobody out there in the deep as the ball races away to the fence.
Play and a miss! Pretty optimistic from Asela Gunaratne. He leans forward to play the cover drive but completely misses as the ball beats the outside edge.
Length ball outside off, left alone for the keeper to collect.
Mumba comes charging in and spears in a full ball around off, gets it to angle in as Gunaratne drives back down the ground. The fileder from mid on does well to run to his left and cut it off.
Back of a length on the hips, it's worked away down to fine leg for a single.
From around the wicket again, it's floated on middle and off, kept out off the front foot to end the over.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Flatter and straighter on middle and leg, it's clipped behind square on the leg side for a run.
Full and attacking the stumps, it's driven to long on for one run.
From around the wicket now, it's looped up well outside off, Gunaratne pushes it to covers.
Tossed up on the stumps, Karunaratne gets to the pitch of the delivery and drives it down to long on for a single.
Bowls it wide of the crease and on the stumps, Asela powers it towards mid on.
A official warning has been given to Carl Mumba for running on the danger area.
Back of a length ball on off, AG doesn't play at it.
Hits the deck hard this time and bangs in short on middle, Gunaratne ducks to evade it.
Asela Gunaratne walks in next!

OUT! Straight to the fielder! Sri Lanka are 4 down and Carl Mumba has taken three of them. Certainly not a wicket taking delivery this one but the home side won't mind it at all. Bowls a low full toss outside off, de Silva goes for the drive but ends up chipping it straight to Chari at short extra cover who makes no mistake. Mumba is absolutely pumped up and boy, why won't he be?
Another misfield! Good length ball on off, Dimuth taps it towards gully and a misfield allows them to cross over. This is not pleasing from the Zimbabweans.

FOUR! Sloppy from Malcolm Waller! Mumba hurls it on off, Karunaratne drives it straight to covers where Waller makes a complete mess of it as the ball goes through him and races to the fence for a boundary.
Drags his length back and serves it on off, it's defended well on the off side.
Flatter one outside off, punched off the back foot towards covers.
Slips this one down the leg side, de Silva tries to pull it towards fine leg but misses.
Around off, pushed toward short extra cover.
FOUR! Lovely! Tossed up ball around off, de Silva skips down the track, meets the pitch of the ball and hits it straight back over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Full and around off, defended into the ground.
Full around off, it's driven back to the bowler. That'll be the end of the over.
Dimuth Karunaratne plays this to the left of the bowlers, towards mid on. Won't get any run for it, though.
On a length once more, same line from Mumba, it's hit down to mid on. No run taken.
Length ball angling across the left-hander, DK strides forward and shoulders his arms to this one.
Back of a length delivery on the stumps, it's worked in front of mid-wicket off the back foot. Karunaratne wants the single but is quickly sent back.
Length ball on middle and leg, it's flicked towards the square leg region. No run taken.
Carl Mumba is back into the attack.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
Over the wicket now, it's kept out from within the crease.
Has a change of angle and comes from around the wicket, tosses it up on off stump as it's driven a bit square on the off side for a single.
Flatter and shorter on the stumps, Karunaratne makes room and punches it down to long on for one run.
FOUR! Sliding down the leg side, Dimuth just helps it down the leg side and sends it all the way to the boundary line.
Comes from over the wicket and flights it up outside off, it's worked down to mid on.
Sean Williams comes on to bowl now.
Punched down to long on for a single this time.
Outside off, Karunaratne gets it right this time. Brings out the reverse sweep again and hits it through backward point for a brace.
Gets to the pitch of the ball and works it towards mid-wicket.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Good stop from Masakadza! Tossed up around off, Dimuth gets into the position to play the reverse sweep but Hamilton at first slip premeditates the shot and moves quickly to his left to stop it.
Outside off, turning in, Karunaratne gets back and flicks it towards short fine leg.
Replica of the last ball.
Length delivery on off, de Silva gets back and presents full face of the bat towards covers.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Fuller in length and around off, Dhananjaya drives it on the up towards short extra cover where the fielder dives to his right to stop it.
Good length delivery on middle, tucked behind square on the leg side for nothing.
Short and going down leg, de Silva ducks to let that one go. The keeper dives to his left but fails to collect as the ball goes off his gloves to fine leg. Two byes taken.
Outside off, DK gets forward and pads it away on the off side.
FOUR! Shot, that! Gives this one a bit more flight around off, Karunaratne drives it on the up through covers for a boundary.
FOUR LEG BYES! Loopy ball around off, turning in again. Dimuth looks to play the reverse sweep again but misses as the ball goes off the pads and down to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Outside off, turning in as Karunaratne looks to reverse sweep it and is hit on the pads.
Tossed up ball around off, de Silva opens the face of the bat and glides it towards third man for a single.
Loopy ball around off, flicked towards the leg side for a single.
Play and a miss! Fired in full outside off, de Silva looks to squeeze it out on the off side but is unable to do so.
Tight line from Donald Tiripano as he attacks the stumps, Dhananjaya leans forward and defends.
Length ball outside off, de Silva crouches low, opens the face of the bat and guides it towards gully. Is unable to get it past the diving gully fielder who does well to stop it.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full ball around off, it's driven to mid off.
Tiripano starts off from around the wicket and bowls it on a length outside off, DK gets a bottom edge towards covers as he looks to cut it away. A single is taken.

Some drama to end the over. Cremer with a full ball on the stumps, de Silva looks to defend but the ball takes the bottom edge. It rolls behind and just misses the off pole. A few "ooohhhss" and "aaahhhss" from the Zimbabwean players. Was pretty close.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Loopy leg spinner on middle and off, blocked.
Flighted outside leg, de Silva keeps bat and pad close together and presents a tight defensive shot.
Cremer continues from around the wicket and loops it up around off, Karunaratne leans across and turns it through to deep mid-wicket for one.
Tossed up from around the wicket, it's flicked square on the leg side for one run.
Driven through the covers by the batsman. That's the end of the over.
Fired in full and well outside off, Dimuth drives it straight to the short cover fielder.
It's pitched up there outside off, driven to mid off for no run.
Quite straight from Donald on this occasion, on middle and leg, Karunaratne whips this straight to the man at mid-wicket.
Good length delivery angling across, it's kept out off the front foot into the track ahead.
Back of a length delivery just outside off, DK offers a solid back foot defense.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full on the stumps, it's driven towards mid off.
Similar ball, same result. It's padded away.
Graeme Cremer loops it up around leg, it's padded away by Dhananjaya de Silva.
Pitched outside off, it's turning towards off as de Silva defends from within his crease.
Cremer comes from around the wicket to Dhananjaya de Silva, it's a bit on the shorter side, blocked off the back foot.
Brilliant line from Donald Tiripano. Is very consistent with it. Keeps it around the off stump as it's left alone for the keeper to collect. Good ball to end the over.
Pitched fractionally ahead of a length, just around the off stump, it's punched back down the ground as the mid off fielder comes across to his left to cut it off.
Straying on the pads, it's tucked through to deep backward square leg for one run.
Length ball on middle and leg, Dimuth makes good use of his wrists and turns it through backward square leg for an easy single.
Just back of a length on middle and off, it's worked in front of mid-wicket.
Good length delivery on the fifth stump line, Karunaratne stands his ground and firmly punches it back down the track.
Drinks break!
Bowls it slower through the air this time, Dhananjaya de Silva takes a big stride forward and defends it with a straight blade.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Attacks the stumps here, it's blocked off the front foot.
The wrong 'un from Graeme Cremer, there's some extra bounce on offer as well. Zips off the surface and catches de Silva on the thigh pad. He didn't pick that up at all.
Good leave from de Silva. Cremer floats it up around off, it turns ever so slightly and just misses the off stump as Dhananjaya makes a watchful leave.
Shorter in length and turning in on middle and leg, Dimuth gets back and turns it through square leg for a single.
de Silva perfectly gets behind the line of the delivery and blocks it out off his back foot to end the over.
Donald angles this length ball in from outside off, Dhananjaya gets behind the line and keeps it out on the off side.
Tailing in on middle and off, it's worked in front of mid-wicket for no run.
Another length delivery from Donald Tiripano, just around off, another solid defensive shot presented by Dhananjaya de Silva.
Pitches this just ahead of a length, outside the line of off stump, it's kept out rather stoutly off the front foot.
Tiripano continues from over the wicket and bowls it on a length outside off, de Silva stays behind the keeps it out on the off side.
de Silva works it through mid-wicket to keep strike.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Floated ball around middle and off, de Silva prods forward in defense.
Tosses it up around middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Around middle and off, Dimuth hangs back and defends.
Tossed up around off, Karunaratne comes down the track and defends it down the track.
Nips back in a touch and de Silva just works it towards short mid-wicket.
Fullish in length and on the pads, clipped behind square on the leg side for a single.
Driven down to mid on for nothing.
Back of a length ball on middle, pulled towards mid-wicket.
Good length ball on off, Karunaratne chops it towards covers.
Length ball on middle and leg, Karunaratne misses his flick and is hit on the pads.
Another change in the bowling as Donald Tiripano comes into the attack!
Quicker through the air around middle, de Silva defends it back to the bowler.
The centurion in the first innings, Dhananjaya de Silva walks in next.

OUT! The decision stays as it is! Graeme Cremer strikes in his very first over! Loopy ball outside off, turning in sharply as Tharanga misses his back foot flick only to be rapped on the pads. Cremer turns back to appeal and umpire Ian Gould rules it out. It looked dead plumb to the naked eye but Tharanga still opts for the review. Replays show it to be pitching in line and would have gone on to crash the leg stump. Graeme is all smiles and Zimbabwe are on a roll here.
Upul Tharanga is given out LBW but he takes the review immediately. Is it missing the stumps? Let's wait and find out...
Loopy ball around middle and leg, DK flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Flatter and short on off, Tharanga gets back, opens the face of the blade and glides it behind point for a comfortable three.
Tossed up ball around off, wristed down to long on for another one.
Loopy ball around middle, eased down to long on for a single.
The skipper Graeme Cremer has brought himself into the attack!
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Back of a length ball on middle, DK punches it towards short mid-wicket where the fielder parries the ball to mid on. They look for a single but won't get it.
Good length delivery on middle, Dimuth hangs back in defense.
Fuller on the stumps, it's bunted back to Mpofu.
Back of a length ball on off, Tharanga opens the face of the bat and glides it through point for a single.
Length ball on off, UT makes am easy leave.

Another run out chance goes down abegging! Fuller in length and tailing back in sharply as Karunaratne works it towards short mid-wicket. He sets off for a single and this time Tharanga sends him back. The fielder fires a throw at the keeper's end and Moor fumbles to collect it cleanly. Dimuth dives to get back in and in the end, no damge is done.
Short and down the leg side, DK gets inside the line and lets it go.
Fuller in length and hurled on off, driven straight to the man at mid off.
Short of a length ball on off, punched towards the off side.
FOUR! Sweetly timed! An overpitched delivery on off, Karunaratne presses forward and drives it past covers, it's through the gap and sped away to the fence.
Outside off, it's left alone.
Shortish on off, Tharanga looks to cut as there was some width on offer. Ends up chopping it towards covers.
UT pushes it towards mid on.

Another run out chance! Fullish in length and on middle, Karunaratne drives it towards mid on and calls for a single. Tharanga is once again at the danger end as the throw is fired at the striker's end. The keeper fails to collect it cleanly but had there been a direct hit, Upul was gone for all money.
Fuller in length on middle, defended to the on side.
Angles in a length ball on the pads, Karunaratne glances it through mid-wicket for a couple.
On a length and outside off, Dimuth lifts his bat and lets it through.
Beaten! Fuller in length and in the channel on off, Tharanga prods forward to defend but the ball whizzes past the outside edge to the keeper.

FOUR! Uppish but in the gap! Good length ball outside off, hits one of the cracks there. Tharanga winds up for a drive but is surprised back to bounce there. Ends up driving it uppishly and much to his delight it went through the gap and to the fence for a boundary. The commentator on air says, "There is definitely something in this pitch!"
Fuller and tailing back in, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Fullish in length and served wide outside off, Karunaratne shoulders his arms to that one.
Brilliant stop! Back of a length ball on off, DK punches it through the line towards point where the fielder quickly moves to his right, puts in a dive to save some runs for his side.

Fuller and served wide outside off, Dimuth tries to drive this away from the body and ends up getting a thick outside edge which falls just short of the man at point who dives to his right to stop it.
Gets forward and defends it down on the off side solidly.
FOUR! Crisp! Fuller and width on offer as well, Upul leans into the shot and caresses it through the gap at covers for a boundary along the ground.
Good length ball on middle, Tharanga defends it from within the crease.

Chance of a run out! Fuller in length and angling in, Karunaratne flicks it towards mid on and sets off for a single. There is a shy at the striker's end but it just misses. Replays show Tharanga would have been a goner had that it the stumps.
Fuller in length and angling in, defended off the front foot.
Length ball on off, Karunaratne looks to cut but gets a bottom edge on that one.

FOUR! That's a beautiful cricketing shot. Full and well outside off, room on offer and Tharanga takes full advantage of it. Leans into the drive and middles it perfectly. Gets it through the gap in the covers and across the ropes for a boundary.
Mumba brings out the short one and bangs it in hard, 134 kph, he seems to be really pumped here. Tharanga however picks up the length early and ducks to evade it.
Upul Tharanga is the new man in!

OUT! That's an extremely poor shot. A player of Mendis' quality should know better than that. Mumba keeps it on the shorter side and bowls a back of a length delivery outside off. Maybe Kusal was expecting a fuller ball and hence didn't get into position early. He gets a top edge as he tries to pull and it balloons towards Mpofu at mid on who takes the easiest of catches. Sri Lanka lose their second wicket in quick succession.
It's worked through square leg for an easy single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Going away from Dimuth Karunaratne from around off, keeps a bit low as well as the ball goes under Dimuth's bat.

That's an excellent delivery! Absolute ripper. On an excellent length on off, Mendis is very watchful as he raises his bat skywards to leave it alone. It just went over the off stump. Easy or calculated leave, not sure. But a good delivery in the end.
Slightly fuller in length, pitched outside off, Mendis presents a solid front foot defense.
Just back of a length, in the channel outside off, Kusal Mendis stays behind and punches it on the off side.

That was a close one. Fuller length delivery on middle and off, Mendis looks to whip this through the mid-wicket region but ends up getting a big inside edge onto his pads. It rolls to the leg as no run is taken.
Excellent line from Christopher. Aims the top of off stump as Mendis plays it back down the track.
Good length delivery pitched just outside off, Mendis leans forward and blocks it hard on the off side.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full and swerving in a touch, it's driven towards the mid on region for no run.
Short of a length delivery around off, DK looks to punch it through the off side but gets an inside edge back down the track in the direction of the bowler.
Back of a length delivery on middle and off, tight line from Carl Mumba, it's pulled straight to short mid-wicket.
Good length ball just outside off, Karunaratne opens the face a bit and taps it in front of point.
Fullish length delivery angled across, it's well outside off, Dimuth Karunaratne lunges forward and lets it be.
Coming in on middle and leg, it's flicked through to deep square leg for a single. That will be the end of the over.
Outside off, played to point for nothing.

Ooohhh... Somewhat of a close call, that. A cutter from Christopher Mpofu, it's on a fuller length outside off, Karunaratne is into the shot too early and uppishly drives it towards covers. Falls short of the fielder there.
Length ball outside off, it's left alone by the left-hander. Taking no chances here.
Full ball fired outside off, it's driven to mid off for no run.
Slightly tighter line from Mpofu, just outside the off stump, Dimuth looks to cut it away but ends up getting a bottom edge on the off side.
Back of a length delivery coming in on the body, Kusal Mendis rises on top of the bounce and turns it on the leg side.
Mumba pitches it up and it's well outside off, going away, Mendis leaves it alone.
Angling down the leg side, Mendis looks to pull it away hard behind square on the leg side but misses the ball completely.
Kusal Mendis is the new man in!

OUT! ZIMBABWE STRIKE EARLY! In the first over after the break. Vital breakthrough. Good length ball shaping in on middle and leg, Kaushal Silva flicks this uppishly. Unfortunately for him, it's straight into the hands of Malcolm Waller at short mid-wicket and that's the end of his brief stay.
Good length delivery aiming the top of off stump, Silva stays right behind the line and defends.
Runs straightaway. It's pitched just back of a length and tailing in on the pads, it's clipped past square leg as a single is taken.
We are back for the final session of the day. It will be Karunaratne and Silva to continue with Mumba taking the ball.
... DAY 3, SESSION 3 ...

Another session truly bagged by the Lankans. They came out with an intent after lunch and didn't take much time to wrap up the Zimbabwean innings thereby getting a huge lead of 232 runs. Herath didn't enforce the follow-on, which meant he wanted to give a rest to his bowlers and destroy the hosts further. In the allotted 7 overs, both the Lankan openers will be happy to go into the dressing room without any damage. The lead is close to the 250-run mark and if the Zimbabwe bowlers can't get quick wickets, a long day on the field beckons them. Join us back shortly for the final session.
Fullish and swinging in on off, solidly kept out by Kaushal Silva off the front foot. THAT WILL BE TEA ON DAY 3!

Full in length once more, on off stump this time, DK just checks his shot as he plays it back down the ground. Scurries to the other end as the fielder from mid off cuts it off and throws it towards the keeper. One run completed.
Full and very wide outside off, no way Karunaratne is going to have anything to do with that.
Keeps it on the fuller side and it's outside off, Karunaratne shoulders his arms to this one. Good leave by the southpaw.
Fuller length ball outside off, Dimuth drives it straight to the mid off fielder. Won't get any run for it.
Mpofu pitches it on a good length in the channel outside off, Dimuth strides forward and raises his bat skyward to let it go past him.
Back of a length ball on middle, Karunaratne punches it towards mid on and sets off for a single. There is a shy at the bowler's end but it misses.
Shuffles across and nudges it towards short mid-wicket.
Gets forward and across and flicks it towards the leg side.
Gets back in the crease and works it towards mid-wicket.
Length ball on off, punched with an angled bat towards covers.
On a length and outside off, DK gets on the front foot and defends it down solidly.
Good length delivery once more, just around off, Kaushal opens the face of the bat and dabs it in front of gully to end the over.
Length ball outside off, Silva looks to cut it away through the off side but fails to make any connection.
On a good length and pitched outside off, it's blocked in front of the cover region.
Fuller length delivery outside the off stump, Kaushal Silva just checks his drive as he plays it. Luckily for him, it went along the ground to the cover fielder.
Shortens the length back on this a bit and drops it outside off, Silva plays it in front of covers for no run.
FOUR! GLORIOUS STROKE! Full and wide outside off, Kaushal Silva leans into the shot and elegantly drives it through the covers to get a boundary to his name. Couldn't have played that any better.
FOUR! Poor ball and it's easily put away. Straying on the pads, it's glanced fine down the leg side and sent across the fence for a boundary. As easy as they come.
Good length delivery coming in on middle and off, Karunaratne stays deep within his crease and keeps it out off the back foot.
Fullish in length and swinging away outside off, Kaushal Silva drives it past the short cover fielder. But the man at mid off does well to run to his left and slide to cut it off. One run taken.
Another full ball fired in on middle and leg, nice and straight from Carl Mumba, it's kept out confidently on the on side.
Full outside off, Silva drives it back down the track as Mumba gets low and stops the ball on his followthrough.
Short of a length ball on middle, Silva swivels and looks to pull this one. He misses it completely and gets hit on the rib cage as the ball then dies down on the ground.
Back of a length ball on off, tapped towards the off side for a brisk single.
Lovely stop! Fuller in length and outside off, Silva leans into it and drives it towards covers where the fielder dives to his right and stops a certain boundary.
Back of a length ball on off, punched off the back foot towards the bowler.
First run on the board in this innings! Angles it on the pads, Karunaratne tucks it towards backward square leg for a single.
Pitches it up around off, tailing back in. Karunaratne looks to drive but gets it off the inner part of the bat towards mid on.
Good length just outside off, Dimuth lifts his bat and lets it go through to Moor.
Good length outside off, KS looks to cut but gets it off the bottom edge towards covers.
Banged in short on middle, Silva ducks to evade it.
Shortish on off, Kaushal Silva will never fiddle with it.
Back of a length delivery on off, Silva makes another leave.
Length ball on off, moving away a shade as K. Silva makes another watchful leave.
On a good length and outside off, Silva stands tall in the crease and allows it to go.
Carl Mumba will have a go with the cherry from the other end!
Good length ball outside off, Karunaratne has got nothing to do with it.
Touch full and curling in, DK works it towards short mid-wicket.
Good length ball served once again on off, Dimuth lifts his bat and lets it go.
In the channel outside off, Karunaratne shoulders his arms to that one.
Fuller in length and angling in on the pads, flicked towards short mid-wicket where the fielder dives to his left to stop that one.
Starts off with a length delivery, tailing back in as well. Dimuth defends it from within the crease.
